units: Sifré Num. 153 sq. (with ref. to Num. XXX, 5; 8; 12) ; v. שְׁתִיקָה.—2) (חָרַשׁ II Pi.) making deaf, deafening.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 86a:3">B. Kam. 86ᵃ</cite> <he>לפי שא״א לח׳ וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>להַחֲרִישׁ</he>) because it is not possible to cause deafness without afflicting a wound, a drop of blood &c.; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 98a">ib. 98ᵃ</cite>
